Name: Multiplayer Calendar Planner
Author: Reprodudix
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/0GZTVgr/multiplayer-calendar-planner.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This is a mod that adds a collaborative calendar system for multiplayer. It allows players to reserve and unreserve days for activities like Robin's building projects or gathering wood in the Secret Woods, ensuring all players stay in sync.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game via SMAPI.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install for All Players[/b]
Every player in the multiplayer game needs to install the mod. If a player does not have the mod installed, they will not be able to see or interact with the calendar events.

[*][b]Start a Multiplayer Game[/b]
Begin your multiplayer game as usual, or use the planner in single-player mode to organize your activities.

[*][b]Reserve a Day[/b]
To reserve an activity, click on a day in the calendar. A menu will appear where you can select the activity (e.g., Robin's building projects or Secret Woods).

[i]* When Robin starts a construction project, it will automatically be added to the calendar for the number of days it takes to complete the construction.[/i]

[*][b]Unreserve a Day[/b]
To unreserve an activity, click the day again and choose the option to remove the reservation.

[*][b]Season Reset[/b]
At the start of each season, the calendar data will automatically be cleared for all players.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Works with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and supports multiplayer.
[*]Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.
[/list]
